text: Meet HexaView. The trust console for security.
Security teams juggle dozens of tools, and drown in thousands of alerts.
Cloud, on-prem and OT live in separate consoles. Each tool holds a fragment. Attackers live in the gaps.
So we brought it all into one platform.
One platform. Every function. Full control. A live, explainable Resilience Index, built from all of your security tooling.
Integrated, not assembled. Connect the security tooling you already own, from any vendor, into one model across IT and OT.
When a leaked password becomes a live attack, HexaView joins the dots, and contains it before any data leaves.
Act on any alert, right where you see it. Every change is written back to the source tool, with approval, and fully audited.
For ports and shipping, HexaView watches every terminal and every vessel. Cranes, gates and bridge systems, monitored passively, so operations never stop.
IMO, IACS, NIS2, ISPS and IEC 62443, all tracked in one place, with evidence ready for class surveys and port authorities.
Behind it, a 24/7 managed SOC detects and contains threats in minutes, while AI-driven penetration testing proves your defences hold, terminal by terminal.
Any industry, anywhere, across IT and OT. One source of truth, in real time.
HexaView. Visibility you can act on.
HexaView. Visibility you can act on. Available now from Cyber Dockside.
